assertions.statement: Creating the user returns HTTP status 200.
assertions.subject: create.response.http_status

assertions.statement: Creating the user returns business code 200.
assertions.subject: create.response.business_code

assertions.statement: Exactly one created User row exists.
assertions.subject: created_user.count

assertions.statement: The created User stores the requested username.
assertions.subject: created_user.username

assertions.statement: The created User stores the requested email.
assertions.subject: created_user.email

assertions.statement: The created User remains active as requested.
assertions.subject: created_user.is_active

assertions.statement: The created User remains a non-superuser as requested.
assertions.subject: created_user.is_superuser

assertions.statement: The created User retains the requested null department.
assertions.subject: created_user.dept_id
